description: In literal-only mode, attributes in content can still use the iterator
notes: In literal-only mode the spec makes no variables available, and the README doesn't say whether iterators are an exception. hashicorp/hcl evaluates labels, the attributes of generated blocks and the for_each of nested dynamic blocks with an evaluation context of its own that holds the iterators (iteration.EvalContext in ext/dynblock/iteration.go), which it creates even when it was given none.
